 Naomi Watts Brings DeMellier’s Sleek Stockholm Shoulder Bag Stateside
 WWD Follow Julia Teti Add to Preferred Sources Wed, November 4, 2026 at 7:21 PM UTC Naomi Watts continued her "All's Fair" Season Two press rounds in New York City on Tuesday with a fresh look courtesy of Balmain and DeMellier .
 The Oscar-nominated actress was spotted sporting Balmain's Cloqué Jacquard dress, crafted with a high neckline and three-quarter-length sleeves. The textural piece featured contrasting shades of crushed purple and green throughout.
 More from WWD

 Naomi Watts 
 The pops of color continued with Watts' pointed-toe butter yellow pumps, contrasted by sheer black polka dot tights. A set of statement gold earrings and black sunglasses completed the ensemble, with Watts also toting her hero accessory in hand.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Watts carried DeMellier's Stockholm shoulder bag for an added dose of quiet luxury. The bag, which retails for $595 and was designed by the label's all-female London-based design team, was crafted in black fine-grain leather with a distinct east-west shoulder bag silhouette.
 Naomi Watts
 Though crafted with a compact contour, the DeMellier Stockholm shoulder bag featured a spacious interior with the brand's signature hand-knotted leather pull. The bag's flexible tubular handles elongated the piece and balanced out the overall silhouette.
 Founded by Mireia Llusia-Lindh in 2017, DeMellier is a London-based label that specializes in ethical and sustainable handbags for women, by women. Along with its shoulder design, DeMellier's Stockholm collection features the larger $725 Stockholm design, with a softly curved bowling-inspired silhouette; the midi variation; and the Rebecca Donaldson collaborative iteration.
 The DeMellier London Stockholm shoulder bag in black.
 Watts is currently promoting the second season of the Hulu series "All's Fair." The show follows a high-powered divorce attorney and her all-female law firm. "All's Fair" also stars Niecy Nash, Kim Kardashian, Teyana Taylor and Sarah Paulson, among others. The first three episodes of Season Two are now available to stream.
